nodes.label: Firefighters at Active Fire Scene
nodes.description: Dramatic action photograph showing multiple German firefighters (Feuerwehr) in dark navy protective gear with high-visibility yellow-green reflective stripes, wearing white helmets and carrying bright yellow SCBA (self-contained breathing apparatus) tanks on their backs. The text 'FEUERWEHR' is visible on the jackets. The firefighters are seen from behind, advancing toward a smoldering debris field with smoke rising in the background. The scene depicts active incident response at what appears to be a structural collapse or burned-out building, with overhead power lines visible. The mood is intense, professional, and documentary-style. Color palette: dark navy, bright yellow, lime green, smoky white/grey, with charred debris in earth tones.
nodes.subject: German firefighters at an active fire/rescue scene
